test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ravi travels from City A to City B and from City B to City A in 4 hours. If the average speed of the total journey is 68.3 km/h, what is the distance between City A and City B?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Average Speed** is defined as **Total Distance** divided by **Total Time**.

Total Distance (A to B + B to A) = **Average Speed** × **Total Time**

⇒ Total Distance = 68.3 × 4 = 273.2 km

Since the distance between A and B is exactly half of the round-trip distance:

Distance AB = 273.2 ÷ 2 = 136.6 km

**∴ The correct answer is 136.6 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Average Speed** of the journey = 68.3 km/h

**Total Time** taken for the round trip = 4 hr

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48e721136b618b71fb6fdcb294c6c95ca1953285c8cec7cdf516c57bcffd023c.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Total Distance = Average Speed × Total Time

Distance (A to B) = Total Distance ÷ 2

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total distance covered by Ravi = 68.3 × 4

⇒ Total distance = 273.2 km

⇒ Let the distance between City A and City B be 'd'.

⇒ Total Distance = Distance(A→B) + Distance(B→A) = d + d = 2d

⇒ 2d = 273.2

⇒ d = 273.2 ÷ 2

⇒ d = 136.6 km

**∴ The correct answer is 136.6 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

Average Speed = (Total Distance) ÷ (Total Time). It is not the simple arithmetic mean of speeds unless times are equal.

Harmonic Mean for Equal Distances

If a person travels equal distances at speeds v₁ and v₂, the average speed = (2 × v₁ × v₂) ÷ (v₁ + v₂).

Basic Relation

Distance = Speed × Time | Time = Distance ÷ Speed.</p
